import sys

def run_file(filename: str):
    """Read and evaluate a Mini source file."""
    try:
        with open(filename) as f:
            source = f.read()
    except FileNotFoundError:
        print(f"[runner] File not found: {filename!r}")
        sys.exit(1)

    try:
        result = run(source)
        print(result)
    except (LexError, ParseError, RuntimeError_) as e:
        print(f"Error: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

# Usage: run_file("program.mini")
print("File runner defined.")
description: run_file(filename) reads source from file, calls run(source) (the full pipeline: lex, parse, evaluate), prints result. Catches FileNotFoundError and three interpreter errors (LexError, ParseError, RuntimeError_), prints to stderr, exits with code 1. Entry point for running .mini files.

Three error types map to three pipeline stages: LexError (tokenize), ParseError (parse), RuntimeError_ (evaluate). Single except clause handles all, unified error UX.
